## Summary

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] Public exports and event/response formats remain compatible, or the change is documented.
- [ ] Security-boundary changes are covered by tests and documentation.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, real tfvars, generated Terraform state, or unrelated artifacts are included.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant fixture, type, package, Docker, or Terraform checks

List commands not run and why.
